theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Archetype 1 (Organic Trust)
theme_and_archetype.description: A highly professional, minimal, and functional enterprise dashboard designed for HR admins. Focuses on clarity, structure, and low cognitive load. Colors are strictly functional, separating different node types by subtle tint while keeping the overall palette neutral and sophisticated.

typography.strategy: Professional Enterprise. Clean and highly legible at small sizes for dense interfaces.

scale.label: text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.05em] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Three-pane IDE/Canvas layout. Full viewport height (100vh). No page scrolling, only pane scrolling.

structure.navbar: h-14 border-b border-border bg-surface px-4 flex items-center justify-between z-40 relative
structure.left_sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border bg-surface flex flex-col z-30
structure.right_panel: w-80 border-l border-border bg-surface flex flex-col shadow-[-4px_0_24px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] z-30
structure.bottom_simulation_panel: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-48 border-t border-border bg-surface z-40 transform transition-transform

layout_and_spacing.canvas_controls: absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-20 flex gap-2
layout_and_spacing.minimap: absolute bottom-4 right-4 z-20 border border-border shadow-sm rounded-md overflow-hidden bg-surface

nodes.style: bg-surface border border-border rounded-lg shadow-sm min-w-[240px] transition-all duration-200
nodes.header: px-3 py-2 border-b border-border flex items-center gap-2
nodes.handles: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-surface border-2 border-slate-400 dark:border-slate-500

sidebar_draggable_items.style: p-3 mb-2 border border-border rounded-md cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:bg-surface_hover hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-600 transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 text-sm font-medium

simulation_logs.log_entry: px-4 py-2 border-b border-border hover:bg-surface_hover flex items-start gap-3

interactions_and_motion.nodes: Subtle scale up (scale: 1.02) on drag start. Smooth border color transition on hover.
interactions_and_motion.panels: Slide in/out for right panel and bottom simulation drawer using framer-motion.
interactions_and_motion.edges: Animated dashed strokes for active/simulating workflows. Smooth step bezier curves.
interactions_and_motion.feedback: Use toast notifications (Sonner) for Save, Export, Import, and Validation warnings.

ui_libraries.core: Tailwind CSS, React Flow (for canvas), Framer Motion
ui_libraries.components: Shadcn UI (Button, Input, Select, Switch, Dialog, Tabs, ScrollArea)

abstract_background.description: Subtle wavy abstract background, suitable for empty states or login screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup React Flow with `reactflow` library. Ensure proper React Flow Provider wraps the workspace.
2. Implement a global store (Zustand or Context) for nodes, edges, and workflow state.
3. Build custom Node components matching the `node_types` color scheme.
4. Implement Drag & Drop using HTML5 drag events or `@dnd-kit/core` interacting with React Flow's `onDrop`.
5. Ensure the Right Panel only mounts when a node is selected, updating the store `onChange`.
6. Apply Dark Mode using Tailwind's `dark:` class strategy via a global provider.
7. Include comprehensive validation logic before allowing export/simulation (e.g., checking for unconnected nodes).
